atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify relevant internal and external factors affecting its purpose, strategy, and ability to achieve expected quality management results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented process for identifying internal and external factors.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must monitor and review information about these internal and external factors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of monitoring and review of relevant factors.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine if climate change is a relevant factor.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented determination regarding climate change relevance.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify relevant interested parties for the quality management system, considering their actual or potential impact on meeting customer and legal requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if a list or analysis of interested parties exists and is periodically reviewed.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the requirements of relevant interested parties that affect the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documentation identifying interested parties’ requirements relevant to the QMS.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must monitor and review information about relevant interested parties and their requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of periodic review and update of interested parties and their requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must define the boundaries and applicability of its quality management system to establish its scope.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if the scope is defined and boundaries are described in QMS documentation.

atomic_requirements.text: When defining the scope, the organisation must consider relevant internal and external factors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify if context analysis (4.1) is referenced in scope determination records.

atomic_requirements.text: When defining the scope, the organisation must consider requirements of relevant interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if interested parties’ requirements (4.2) are considered in scope documentation.

atomic_requirements.text: When defining the scope, the organisation must consider its products and services, and apply all applicable standard requirements within the defined scope.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review if all products/services in scope are included and exclusions are justified.

atomic_requirements.text: The scope of the organisation’s quality management system must be available and maintained as documented information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for a current, controlled document stating the QMS scope.

atomic_requirements.text: The documented scope must state the types of products and services covered, and justify any standard requirements deemed not applicable.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify scope document lists covered products/services and justifies any exclusions.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify necessary inputs and expected outputs for each quality management process.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process maps or descriptions for listed inputs and outputs for each process.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must define the sequence and interaction of quality management processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process flowcharts or diagrams showing process sequence and interactions.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish and apply criteria and methods, including monitoring and performance indicators, to ensure effective process control.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Examine documented methods, criteria, and indicators for process monitoring and measurement.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine and provide the resources needed for each quality management process.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource allocation records or process documentation specifying required resources.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must assign responsibilities and authorities for each quality management process.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process documentation or organisational charts for assigned responsibilities and authorities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must address risks and opportunities for each process as required by clause 6.1.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk and opportunity assessments linked to each process, as per clause 6.1.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must evaluate processes and implement changes needed to achieve expected results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of process reviews and evidence of changes made to improve results.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must improve its processes and the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of continual improvement actions and their implementation.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management is accountable for the effectiveness of the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check management review records for evidence of top management's accountability and leadership.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures the quality policy and objectives are set and aligned with the organisation’s context and strategy.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review quality policy and objectives for alignment with business strategy and context.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures QMS requirements are integrated into business processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process maps or procedures showing QMS requirements embedded in business processes.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management promotes process approach and risk-based thinking.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for communications or meeting minutes promoting process approach and risk-based thinking.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures necessary resources for the QMS are available.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource allocation records, budgets, or decisions supporting the QMS.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management communicates the importance of effective quality management and QMS conformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check internal communications or meeting records for messages on QMS importance.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures the QMS achieves intended results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review management review outputs and performance data for achievement of QMS results.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management actively involves, guides, and supports people to contribute to QMS effectiveness.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of leadership involvement and support in QMS activities.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management promotes continual improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for communications or actions by top management promoting improvement.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management supports other managers to demonstrate leadership in their areas.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for evidence of top management supporting and empowering other managers.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures customer and applicable legal requirements are determined, understood, and regularly met.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review processes for identifying and meeting customer and legal requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures risks and opportunities affecting product/service conformity and customer satisfaction are identified and addressed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessment and action plans related to customer and product/service conformity.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management maintains focus on enhancing customer satisfaction.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review management review and communications for focus on customer satisfaction.

atomic_requirements.text: Objectives are cascaded within the organisation (declined to functions/departments) and their implementation status is verified.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Departmental targets, progress reviews, objective status discussed in records (checklist 5.1.1: declinazione + verifica stato di attuazione).
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must establish, implement and maintain a quality policy appropriate to the organisation’s purpose, context and strategic direction.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy content for coherence with context, strategy, customer and interested-party needs.

atomic_requirements.text: The quality policy must provide a framework for setting quality objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify objectives are traceable to policy statements.

atomic_requirements.text: The quality policy must include a commitment to satisfy applicable requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy wording for explicit commitment to customer, statutory and regulatory requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The quality policy must include a commitment to continual improvement of the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy wording for explicit commitment to continual improvement.

atomic_requirements.text: The quality policy must be available and maintained as documented information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify existence of current, approved, signed and/or dated policy document.

atomic_requirements.text: The quality policy must be communicated, understood and applied within the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of communication and awareness (training records, interviews, internal communications).

atomic_requirements.text: The quality policy must be available to relevant interested parties, as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if policy is accessible to relevant interested parties (website, noticeboard, distribution records).

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must ensure relevant roles have assigned, communicated, and understood responsibilities and authorities within the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check organigrams, job descriptions, or process flows for clarity and communication of roles, responsibilities, and authorities.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to ensure the quality management system meets ISO 9001 requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review job descriptions or assignments showing who ensures QMS compliance with ISO 9001.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to ensure processes deliver their intended outputs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process owner assignments and related responsibilities in procedures or job descriptions.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to report on QMS performance and improvement opportunities, especially to top management.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review reporting lines and responsibilities for QMS performance and improvement in job descriptions or management review records.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to promote customer focus throughout the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check assignments or procedures showing who is responsible for promoting customer focus.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to maintain QMS integrity during planned changes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review change management procedures and assignments ensuring QMS integrity is maintained during changes.

atomic_requirements.text: Actions to address risks and opportunities must be proportionate to their potential impact on product and service conformity, and their effectiveness must be evaluated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if actions are scaled to risk impact and if effectiveness evaluation is documented.

atomic_requirements.text: Risks AND opportunities are determined, linked to the organisation's context (4.1) and interested-party requirements (4.2).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Risk register, FMEA, SWOT-derived register or equivalent; entries reference QMS objectives or context issues. Opportunities must appear, not only threats.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: A method and criteria for analysing and classifying risks are defined (e.g. probability x severity matrix, FMEA scoring, qualitative classes).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: The document states HOW risks are scored or ranked: scales, thresholds, classification rules.
atomic_requirements.review_note: 6.1 asks to determine risks, not to use a scoring method

atomic_requirements.text: The declared criteria are actually APPLIED: each risk entry carries the score/class produced by the stated method — the methodology is not merely described.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Spot-check register entries: every risk has a value/class consistent with the declared scale. A methodology chapter followed by an unscored risk list fails this item.
atomic_requirements.review_note: no scoring method is required, so none has to be applied

atomic_requirements.text: Actions to address the identified risks and opportunities are planned, with an owner for each significant entry.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Mitigation/exploitation actions column or linked action plan; named role or person responsible.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The risk analysis is kept current: a revision need or review cadence is identified (e.g. reviewed at management review or on significant change).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Revision date/history on the register; risk review as a management review input.
atomic_requirements.review_note: no review cadence is required for the risk analysis

atomic_requirements.text: Quality objectives must align with the quality policy.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives against the quality policy for consistency.

atomic_requirements.text: Quality objectives must be measurable, with defined metrics.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify each objective has a metric and target value.

atomic_requirements.text: Quality objectives must consider applicable requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives reference customer, legal, or other relevant requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Objectives must relate to product/service conformity and customer satisfaction improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review objectives for relevance to conformity and customer satisfaction.

atomic_requirements.text: Quality objectives must be monitored for progress.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for KPI dashboards, progress reports, or management review records.

atomic_requirements.text: Quality objectives must be communicated within the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of communication, e.g., meeting minutes, postings, or intranet.

atomic_requirements.text: Objectives must be updated as appropriate and documented information maintained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for current documented objectives and evidence of updates.

atomic_requirements.text: Each objective carries a timescale or deadline for achievement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Date / quarter / 'by end of year' per entry. Objectives with metric and target but no time bound are PARTIAL.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Planning to achieve the objectives is defined: what will be done, resources required, who is responsible, and how results will be evaluated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Action plan columns or linked actions: activity, owner, resources, evaluation method.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify and provide resources needed to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource planning and allocation documents for QMS establishment, maintenance, and improvement.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider the capabilities and limitations of its existing internal resources.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check resource assessment reports or management review minutes for evaluation of internal resources.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider what resources to obtain from external providers.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review supplier evaluation and procurement records for identification of externally sourced resources.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine and make available the people needed for effective QMS operation and process control.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check staffing plans, job assignments, and evidence of personnel availability for QMS and process needs.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine, provide, and maintain the infrastructure needed for process operation and product/service conformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review infrastructure lists, maintenance records, and evidence of suitability for process and product requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine, provide, and maintain the environment needed for process operation and product/service conformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records on environmental controls, monitoring, and maintenance relevant to process and product requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: When monitoring or measurement is used for conformity, the organisation must provide resources to ensure valid and reliable results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review monitoring and measurement resource lists and calibration records for validity and reliability.

atomic_requirements.text: Resources for monitoring and measurement must be suitable for the specific type of activity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check suitability assessments and specifications for monitoring and measurement resources.

atomic_requirements.text: Resources for monitoring and measurement must be maintained for ongoing suitability; documented evidence must be retained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review maintenance logs and documented evidence of resource suitability.

atomic_requirements.text: Where measurement traceability is required, measuring equipment must be calibrated/verified against standards; calibration basis must be documented if standards do not exist.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check calibration certificates and documented calibration bases for measuring equipment.

atomic_requirements.text: Measuring equipment must be identified to determine its calibration status.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review equipment identification and status records.

atomic_requirements.text: Measuring equipment must be protected from adjustments, damage, or deterioration that could affect calibration and measurement results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procedures and records for safeguarding measuring equipment.

atomic_requirements.text: If measuring equipment is found unfit for use, the organisation must assess impact on previous results and take appropriate action.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of nonconforming equipment and actions taken regarding affected measurements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the knowledge needed for process operation and product/service conformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check knowledge management plans or competence matrices for identified organisational knowledge.

atomic_requirements.text: Required organisational knowledge must be maintained and made available as needed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented procedures, manuals, or knowledge bases for availability and maintenance.

atomic_requirements.text: When facing changing needs and trends, the organisation must consider current knowledge and determine how to acquire or access additional knowledge and updates.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check management review or change management records for assessment and acquisition of new knowledge.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the necessary competence for each person performing work affecting quality performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review competence matrices, job descriptions, or role profiles for defined competence per activity.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must ensure these persons are competent based on appropriate education, training, or experience.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence that assigned persons meet defined competence through qualifications, training, or experience records.

atomic_requirements.text: Where needed, the organisation must take action to acquire competence and evaluate the effectiveness of these actions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of competence actions (e.g. training) and evidence of effectiveness evaluation (e.g. tests, assessments).

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented evidence of competence.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for retained records such as training certificates, qualification documents, or experience logs.

atomic_requirements.text: Competence control covers persons working under the organisation's control who are NOT employees (external workers, outsourcers) where they affect quality.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Supplier/contractor competence evidence or contractual competence requirements (checklist 7.2: 'sia interne, sia esterne').
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: People working under the organisation's control must be aware of the quality policy.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training records, meeting minutes, communications showing quality policy shared.

atomic_requirements.text: People working under the organisation's control must be aware of relevant quality objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of quality objectives communicated, e.g. presentations, emails, training materials.

atomic_requirements.text: People must be aware of their contribution to QMS effectiveness and benefits of improved performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training, communications, or questionnaires showing awareness of individual contribution and improvement benefits.

atomic_requirements.text: People must be aware of the consequences of not meeting QMS requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of communications or training on nonconformity implications, e.g. shared NCs, instructions.

atomic_requirements.text: Awareness extends to non-employee persons involved in the organisation's processes (contractors, outsourcers) where relevant.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Contractor induction evidence or contractual awareness requirements (checklist 7.3: 'comprensivo anche di fornitori ed outsourcers').
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must define what information is to be communicated internally and externally about the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review communication procedures or plans specifying what is communicated about the QMS.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine when internal and external communications about the quality management system should take place.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check schedules, procedures, or records showing timing/frequency of QMS communications.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify with whom internal and external communications about the quality management system are to be shared.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Examine communication matrices, stakeholder lists, or procedures indicating communication recipients.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must specify how internal and external communications about the quality management system are to be delivered.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented methods or channels for QMS communication (e.g., email, meetings, notices).

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine who is responsible for communicating internally and externally about the quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check role descriptions, procedures, or communication plans assigning communication responsibilities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must have documented information required by ISO 9001:2015 in its quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if all documents required by the standard exist and are controlled.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must have documented information it deems necessary for the effectiveness of its quality management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review the list of controlled documents and compare with key processes and risks.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must be properly identified and described, e.g. title, date, author, or reference number.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check sample documents for required metadata fields.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must have appropriate format and media, such as language, software version, graphics, paper or electronic.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documents for consistent format and media as defined by the organisation.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must be reviewed and approved for suitability and adequacy before use.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procedure and evidence of review/approval on sample documents.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must be available and suitable for use where and when needed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Ask users and check access to documents at points of use.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must be adequately protected from loss of confidentiality, improper use, or loss of integrity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review access controls and protection measures for documents.

atomic_requirements.text: Externally provided documented information needed for the QMS must be identified and controlled, including retention and disposal.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procedure and records for control of external documents and retention/disposal actions.

atomic_requirements.text: Records kept as evidence of conformity must be protected from unintentional alteration.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if records are protected from editing or deletion.

atomic_requirements.text: Document control covers all key processes (not only a subset).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Document register / index spans the full management system scope.
atomic_requirements.review_note: extent of documented information is the organisation's choice (7.5.1 b)

atomic_requirements.text: Obsolete documents are clearly identified and removed or marked as such.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Procedure references obsolete-copy handling; no draft/obsolete versions in active use.
atomic_requirements.review_note: the 2015 edition has no explicit requirement on obsolete documents

atomic_requirements.text: Processes to meet product and service requirements, and actions from clause 6, are planned, implemented, and controlled.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process maps, procedures, and planning records for evidence of planning and control.

atomic_requirements.text: Criteria are established for processes and for acceptance of products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented criteria in procedures, work instructions, or acceptance checklists.

atomic_requirements.text: Criteria for operational processes are defined and documented.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify process criteria in documented procedures or process descriptions.

atomic_requirements.text: Criteria for acceptance of products and services are defined and documented.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check acceptance criteria in specifications, quality plans, or acceptance records.

atomic_requirements.text: Resources needed to achieve conformity of products and services are determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource planning documents, such as staffing plans or equipment lists.

atomic_requirements.text: Processes are controlled in accordance with established criteria.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process control records and monitoring results against defined criteria.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is determined, maintained, and retained as needed for process confidence and conformity evidence.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records and document control lists for evidence of retention and maintenance.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is kept to provide confidence that processes were performed as planned.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records showing process execution matches plans (e.g., completed checklists, logs).

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is kept to demonstrate conformity of products and services to requirements; planning outputs suit operational activities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review conformity records and planning outputs for adequacy and relevance.

atomic_requirements.text: Planned changes are controlled and unintended changes are reviewed, with actions to mitigate negative effects as needed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check change control records and evidence of review and mitigation actions.

atomic_requirements.text: Externally provided processes are controlled as required by clause 8.4.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review supplier control procedures and records for evidence of control over outsourced processes.

atomic_requirements.text: Operational controls address the risks identified in 6.1: significant risks have a corresponding operational control or procedure.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Cross-check the risk register against procedures/work instructions: each significant risk should map to a control. An identified risk with no corresponding control is a broken chain.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Customer communication must include providing information about products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review procedures, brochures, website, or emails showing product/service information is shared with customers.

atomic_requirements.text: Customer communication must include handling enquiries, contracts, or orders, including changes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check order management and contract review procedures for handling customer requests and changes.

atomic_requirements.text: Customer communication must include obtaining feedback on products and services, including complaints.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review feedback and complaint handling processes and records.

atomic_requirements.text: Customer communication must include managing or controlling customer property.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procedures for handling and communicating about customer property.

atomic_requirements.text: Customer communication must include defining specific requirements for emergency actions, when relevant.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review contracts or procedures for emergency requirements communication.

atomic_requirements.text: Product and service requirements, including all relevant aspects, must be defined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check requirement definition procedures and related documents for completeness.

atomic_requirements.text: Applicable statutory and regulatory requirements for products and services must be determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review requirement lists and compliance checks for legal and regulatory aspects.

atomic_requirements.text: Requirements considered necessary by the organisation must be determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check internal requirement lists and decision records.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must ensure it can meet its stated product and service requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review capability assessments and offer/contract review records.

atomic_requirements.text: Before committing, review customer-specified requirements, including delivery and post-delivery needs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check order review records for customer requirements, delivery, and post-delivery aspects.

atomic_requirements.text: Before committing, review requirements not stated by the customer but necessary for intended use, when known.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review records for identification of unstated but necessary requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Before committing, review requirements specified by the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review records for inclusion of organisation-defined requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Before committing, review applicable statutory and regulatory requirements for products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review records for legal and regulatory requirement checks.

atomic_requirements.text: Before committing, review contract/order requirements differing from previous ones and resolve differences.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check contract/order review records for identification and resolution of requirement differences.

atomic_requirements.text: If the customer does not provide documented requirements, confirm them before acceptance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check order confirmation records where customer requirements were not documented.

atomic_requirements.text: When product or service requirements change, update documented information and inform relevant people.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check change management records and communication logs for updates and notifications.

atomic_requirements.text: A design and development process must be established, implemented, and maintained to ensure product and service provision.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented process for design and development; check implementation evidence.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider the nature, duration, and complexity of design and development activities when planning stages and controls.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check planning documents for consideration of activity nature, duration, and complexity.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider necessary process stages, including applicable design and development reviews.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process documentation for defined stages and review points.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider required verification and validation activities for design and development.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process for inclusion of verification and validation steps.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider responsibilities and authorities involved in the design and development process.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process documentation for assigned roles and responsibilities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider internal and external resource needs for design and development of products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check resource planning in design and development documentation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider the need to control interfaces among people involved in design and development.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process for interface management or communication controls.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider the need to involve customers and users in the design and development process.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process for customer/user involvement steps.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider requirements for subsequent provision of products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process for consideration of downstream requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider the level of design and development control expected by customers and relevant interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process for alignment with customer/party control expectations.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider documented information needed to demonstrate design and development requirements are met.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review list of required documented information for design and development.

atomic_requirements.text: Essential requirements for each type of product and service to be designed and developed must be determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check requirements determination records for each product/service type.

atomic_requirements.text: Functional and performance requirements must be considered in design and development inputs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review input documentation for functional and performance requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Information from previous similar design and development activities must be considered.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if lessons learned or previous project data are referenced in inputs.

atomic_requirements.text: Applicable statutory and regulatory requirements must be considered in design and development inputs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review input documentation for legal and regulatory requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Standards or codes of practice the organisation has committed to must be considered in design and development inputs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check input documentation for referenced standards or codes.

atomic_requirements.text: Potential consequences of failure due to product or service nature must be considered; inputs must be suitable, complete, and unambiguous.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessment and input adequacy checks.

atomic_requirements.text: Any conflicts among design and development inputs must be resolved.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records for input conflict resolution.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information on design and development inputs must be retained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify retention of input records.

atomic_requirements.text: Controls must ensure that intended design and development results are defined.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation determines necessary verification or other activities to ensure external provision meets requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation communicates to external providers the requirements for release of products and services.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation communicates to external providers the requirements for competence, including any required qualifications.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation communicates to external providers the requirements for interactions between provider and organisation.

atomic_requirements.text: Where traceability is required, the organisation must control unique identification of outputs and retain necessary documented information.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must care for customer or external provider property under its control or use.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review procedures and records for handling customer/external provider property.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify, verify, protect, and safeguard customer or external provider property provided for use or incorporation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of identification, verification, and protection of such property.

atomic_requirements.text: If customer or external provider property is lost, damaged, or unsuitable, the organisation must report it and retain documented information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check incident reports and communications to customers/providers.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must implement planned arrangements at appropriate stages to verify product and service requirements are met.

atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review release records for evidence of completed checks or authorised exceptions.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented information about the release of products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify existence of release records for products and services.

atomic_requirements.text: Release records must include evidence of conformity with acceptance criteria.

atomic_requirements.text: Release records must identify the person(s) authorised to approve the release.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review release records for names or signatures of authorised personnel.

atomic_requirements.text: Customers must be informed when outputs are nonconforming, as one possible action.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records or communications showing customers were informed about nonconforming outputs.

atomic_requirements.text: Nonconforming outputs may be accepted by concession, with authorisation; corrections must be verified for conformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records for authorisations of concessions and evidence of verification after correction.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation determines what needs to be monitored and measured.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented list of items/processes to be monitored or measured.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation determines methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation to ensure valid results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review procedures describing monitoring and measurement methods.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation determines when monitoring and measurement must be performed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check schedules or plans specifying monitoring and measurement timing.

atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check management review records for evaluation of QMS performance and effectiveness.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation retains documented evidence of monitoring and measurement results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify existence of records showing monitoring and measurement results.

atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of customer satisfaction monitoring (e.g. surveys, complaints analysis).

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation determines methods to obtain, monitor, and review customer perception information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review procedures or plans for collecting and reviewing customer feedback.

atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check analysis reports or management review inputs showing data evaluation.

atomic_requirements.text: Analysis results are used to evaluate QMS performance and effectiveness.

atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if analysis includes evaluation of planning effectiveness.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must take responsibility for the effectiveness of the environmental management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview top management on their accountability for EMS effectiveness; check management review records.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must ensure the environmental policy and objectives are set and align with strategy and organisational context.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review policy, objectives, and strategy documents for alignment.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must ensure EMS requirements are integrated into business processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process maps, procedures, and interview management on EMS integration.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must ensure necessary resources for the EMS are available.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource allocation records and interview management on resource provision.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must communicate the importance of effective environmental management and EMS compliance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff and management; review communications on EMS importance.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must ensure the EMS achieves its intended outcomes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review performance data, objectives achievement, and management review outputs.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must lead and support people to contribute to EMS effectiveness.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff and management on leadership and support for EMS.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must promote continual improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of continual improvement initiatives and management encouragement.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must support other relevant roles to demonstrate leadership in their areas.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview relevant roles and review evidence of leadership support.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management participates in and leads the management review of the EMS.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: MR minutes list top management among attendees; environmental performance discussed at that level.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must establish, implement and maintain an environmental policy suitable to the organisation’s purpose, context, size, and environmental impacts.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy document for context, size, impacts; confirm it is current and approved.

atomic_requirements.text: The environmental policy must provide a framework for setting environmental objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify policy states it guides or frames environmental objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: The policy must include a commitment to protect the environment, including preventing pollution and other context-relevant commitments.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for explicit commitments to protection, pollution prevention, and context-specific issues.

atomic_requirements.text: The policy wording contains an explicit commitment to fulfil the organisation's compliance obligations (legal and other requirements).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Wording equivalent to 'fulfil compliance obligations' / 'comply with applicable legal and other requirements' in the policy text.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The policy wording contains an explicit commitment to continual improvement of the environmental management system to enhance environmental performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Continual improvement of the EMS must be stated in the policy text itself.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The policy is communicated within the organisation and available to interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Distribution/communication evidence; availability to external parties (website, on request).
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles within the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check organigrams, job descriptions, or internal communications showing assigned and communicated roles and authorities.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to ensure the environmental management system meets ISO 14001 requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify records or documents showing who is responsible for EMS conformity.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to report to them on EMS performance, including environmental performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records or job descriptions assigning responsibility for reporting EMS and environmental performance to top management.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain one or more processes to meet the requirements of 6.1.2 to 6.1.5.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for documented or described planning processes covering 6.1.2–6.1.5 requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information on the processes required by 6.1.2 to 6.1.5 must be available as needed for confidence in their execution.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented procedures or records showing processes are followed as planned.

atomic_requirements.text: When planning the EMS, the organisation must consider relevant internal and external issues from 4.1.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check planning documents or risk assessments referencing context analysis (4.1).

atomic_requirements.text: When planning the EMS, the organisation must consider relevant interested parties’ needs and expectations from 4.2.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check planning or risk assessment documents referencing stakeholder requirements (4.2).

atomic_requirements.text: When planning the EMS, the organisation must consider the scope of its EMS as defined in 4.3.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check planning documents referencing the defined EMS scope (4.3).

atomic_requirements.text: Risks and opportunities to be addressed must be available as documented information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented lists or registers of risks and opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: A methodology for assigning priority to risks is defined AND actually applied to the entries (not only declared).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Spot-check: register entries carry the score/class produced by the declared method.
atomic_requirements.review_note: no prioritisation method is required

atomic_requirements.text: Potential emergency situations are identified among the planning inputs (link to emergency preparedness, 8.2).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Emergency scenarios referenced in the planning/risk documents, coherent with the emergency plan.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Identify environmental aspects and impacts of activities, products, and services within the EMS scope, considering what is controlled or influenced, using a life-cycle perspective.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check aspects register covers all activities, products, services, and life-cycle stages.

atomic_requirements.text: Identify potential emergency situations, including those with possible environmental impacts.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check aspects register and risk assessment for emergency scenarios.

atomic_requirements.text: Consider both normal and abnormal operating conditions when identifying environmental aspects.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review aspects register for inclusion of normal and abnormal conditions.

atomic_requirements.text: Consider planned or new developments, and changes to activities, products, or services when identifying aspects.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if register updates after changes to processes, products, or equipment.

atomic_requirements.text: Consider potential emergency situations and determine significant aspects using established criteria.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review criteria and register for identification of significant aspects, including emergencies.

atomic_requirements.text: Communicate significant environmental aspects to relevant organisational levels and functions, as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of communication (emails, meeting minutes, intranet) of significant aspects.

atomic_requirements.text: An environmental aspects register exists, covering all activities, products and services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Register document present with rows per activity / aspect / impact.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify and have access to all compliance obligations related to its environmental aspects.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check the compliance obligations register covers all relevant environmental requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine how each compliance obligation applies to its activities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review register for explanation of how each obligation applies to the organisation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider compliance obligations when establishing, implementing, maintaining and improving its environmental management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check EMS procedures and records show compliance obligations are considered in system planning and review.

atomic_requirements.text: Each requirement has a compliance-status field (compliant / partial / non-compliant) kept current.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Register includes a status column populated with explicit values, not blank.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a status field is a way to record compliance, not a requirement

atomic_requirements.text: Periodic compliance evaluation is performed and recorded.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Compliance-evaluation reports or signed sign-offs dated within the planned interval.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: A process exists to monitor changes in environmental legislation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Subscription, alert service, periodic legal review, or evidence of updates to the register following new legislation.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a dedicated monitoring process is not required in 6.1.3

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are set for relevant functions and levels, considering significant aspects, compliance obligations, risks and opportunities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented objectives and their link to aspects, compliance, risks/opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are consistent with the organisation’s environmental policy.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Compare objectives with the environmental policy for alignment.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are measurable where practicable.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives for defined metrics and target values.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are monitored.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review monitoring records or reports on objective status.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are communicated within the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of internal communication (emails, meetings, postings).

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are updated as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check revision history or review records for updates to objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental objectives are available as documented information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify existence of documented objectives (plans, programmes, KPIs).

atomic_requirements.text: Actions to achieve each environmental objective are determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check plans or programmes for defined actions per objective.

atomic_requirements.text: Resources required to achieve each environmental objective are determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check plans for specified resources for each objective.

atomic_requirements.text: Responsibility for achieving each environmental objective is assigned.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check plans for named responsible persons for each objective.

atomic_requirements.text: Deadlines for achieving each environmental objective are set.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check plans for completion dates for each objective.

atomic_requirements.text: Methods for evaluating results, including indicators for monitoring progress, are determined for each objective.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check plans for evaluation methods and monitoring indicators.

atomic_requirements.text: Actions to achieve objectives are integrated into the organisation’s business processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check integration of actions in business process documentation or workflow.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify the competencies needed for people whose work affects environmental performance and compliance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check role descriptions or matrices showing required competencies for relevant roles.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must ensure these people are competent based on suitable education, training, or experience.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of qualifications, training records, or experience for relevant personnel.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify training needs related to its environmental aspects and management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training needs analysis or records linking training to environmental aspects.

atomic_requirements.text: Where needed, the organisation must take action to gain required competence and assess the effectiveness of these actions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of actions taken and evidence of effectiveness evaluation (e.g., post-training assessments).

atomic_requirements.text: Appropriate documented information must be available as evidence of competence.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented evidence such as certificates, training records, or experience logs.

atomic_requirements.text: People working under the organisation’s control must be aware of the environmental policy.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff at all levels to confirm awareness of the environmental policy.

atomic_requirements.text: People working under the organisation’s control must be aware of significant environmental aspects and related actual or potential impacts of their work.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff and review records to confirm awareness of significant aspects and impacts.

atomic_requirements.text: People working under the organisation’s control must be aware of their contribution to EMS effectiveness and benefits of improved environmental performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff to confirm understanding of their role in EMS effectiveness and improvement benefits.

atomic_requirements.text: People working under the organisation’s control must be aware of the consequences of not conforming to EMS requirements, including compliance obligations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff to confirm awareness of implications of nonconformity, including compliance failures.

atomic_requirements.text: The EMS includes all documented information required by ISO 14001:2015.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if all documents required by the standard are present and controlled.

atomic_requirements.text: The EMS includes documented information the organisation deems necessary for its effectiveness.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify the organisation has identified and maintains documents it considers necessary for EMS effectiveness.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is created and updated with appropriate identification and description (e.g. title, date, author, reference number).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check sample documents for version, date, author, and reference number.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is controlled to ensure it is available and suitable where and when needed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify document control procedures ensure availability and suitability at points of use.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is protected from loss of confidentiality, improper use, or loss of integrity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review document control for measures protecting confidentiality, integrity, and proper use.

atomic_requirements.text: Externally sourced documented information needed for EMS planning and operation is identified and controlled.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if external documents (e.g. permits) are identified and controlled as required.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental records required by the standard (monitoring results, compliance evaluations, training, communications) are retained and retrievable.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Records exist with dates; retention addressed.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Planned changes must be controlled; unintended changes reviewed and actions taken to mitigate negative environmental impacts.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented change management process and records of change reviews and mitigation actions.

atomic_requirements.text: Externally provided processes, products, or services relevant to EMS outcomes must be controlled or influenced.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review contracts, supplier controls, and evidence of oversight for outsourced activities.

atomic_requirements.text: The EMS must define the type and extent of control or influence applied to external processes, products, or services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check EMS documentation for defined controls and influence criteria for external providers.

atomic_requirements.text: Controls must be established in design and development to address environmental requirements for each life cycle stage.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review design/development procedures and evidence of environmental requirements considered at each stage.

atomic_requirements.text: Environmental requirements for procurement of products and services must be determined, as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procurement procedures and records for environmental criteria applied to purchases.

atomic_requirements.text: Relevant environmental requirements must be communicated to external suppliers, including contractors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review supplier communications, contracts, and evidence of environmental requirements shared.

atomic_requirements.text: Consider providing information on significant environmental impacts related to transport, use, end-of-life treatment, and disposal of products/services.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procedures and records for information provided to customers or users about environmental impacts.

atomic_requirements.text: Processes for clause 8.1 must be available as documented information sufficient to demonstrate they were carried out as planned.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify presence and completeness of documented procedures and records for operational controls.

atomic_requirements.text: FIR (formulari) records are complete, with valid destination and licensed waste operator.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Spot-check FIR forms: destination filled, CER code consistent with material, signed by transporter.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazardous waste is identified and tracked separately with end-to-end traceability.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Hazardous waste codes (CER) appear with chain-of-custody documentation.

atomic_requirements.text: Personnel handling waste have documented training.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Training records for waste-handling staff present and current.
atomic_requirements.review_note: specific training records for waste handlers are not required by 8.1

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation establishes, implements and maintains processes to prepare for and respond to potential emergency situations identified in 6.1.2.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented emergency processes and their application for identified scenarios.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation plans actions to prevent or reduce negative environmental impacts from emergency situations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review emergency plans for actions to prevent or mitigate environmental impacts.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation responds to actual emergency situations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of responses to real emergencies, if any occurred.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation takes actions appropriate to the severity and potential environmental impact of emergencies.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review emergency response actions for appropriateness to the type and severity of emergencies.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation periodically tests planned emergency response actions, where practicable.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of emergency drills or exercises and their frequency.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation periodically reviews and revises emergency processes and planned response actions, especially after emergencies or tests.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of reviews and updates after drills or real emergencies.

atomic_requirements.text: Relevant interested parties, including workers, receive appropriate information and training on emergency preparedness and response.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training records and communication to relevant parties on emergency procedures.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information on emergency preparedness and response processes is available as needed to ensure they are carried out as planned.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify availability and adequacy of documented emergency processes and plans.

atomic_requirements.text: Safety Data Sheets (SDS) are available for hazardous substances on site.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: SDS register or files accessible to operating personnel.
atomic_requirements.review_note: safety data sheets are a legal matter, not a 14001 requirement

atomic_requirements.text: Plans include communication with external authorities and neighbouring sites where applicable.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Contacts and notification protocols included in the plan.
atomic_requirements.review_note: information to interested parties is required only as appropriate

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must evaluate its environmental performance and the effectiveness of its environmental management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for documented process and evidence of periodic performance and EMS effectiveness evaluations.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine what needs to be monitored, measured, and analysed regarding environmental performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review monitoring and measurement plan specifying what is monitored and measured.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must define methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation to ensure valid results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented methods and procedures for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish criteria and appropriate indicators for evaluating environmental performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify documented criteria and indicators used for performance evaluation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine when monitoring and measurement activities must be performed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check monitoring plan or schedule specifying timing of activities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine when monitoring and measurement results must be analysed and evaluated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review schedule or procedure for analysis and evaluation of results.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must ensure monitoring and measurement equipment is calibrated or verified and maintained as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check calibration/maintenance records for relevant equipment.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must communicate relevant environmental performance information internally and externally as identified in its communication processes and compliance obligations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review communication records and processes for internal and external performance information sharing.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must be available as evidence of monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for records showing results of monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation.

atomic_requirements.text: A process is established, implemented, and maintained to evaluate fulfilment of compliance obligations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process description for compliance evaluation; confirm it is implemented and maintained.

atomic_requirements.text: The frequency for evaluating compliance is determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review planning documents or schedules showing how often compliance is evaluated.

atomic_requirements.text: Compliance is evaluated and actions are taken if obligations are not fulfilled.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of compliance evaluations and evidence of actions taken for non-compliance.

atomic_requirements.text: Knowledge and understanding of current compliance status is maintained, with documented evidence of evaluation results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented results of compliance evaluations and confirm awareness of current compliance status.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must be conducted at planned intervals to check if the EMS meets its requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review audit programme and reports for planned audits and scope.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must verify conformity to the organisation’s own EMS requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check audit reports for evaluation against internal EMS requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must verify conformity to ISO 14001:2015 requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check audit reports for evaluation against ISO 14001:2015 clauses.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must check that the EMS is effectively implemented and maintained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review audit findings for evidence of effective EMS implementation and maintenance.

atomic_requirements.text: An internal audit programme must be established, implemented, and maintained, covering frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning, and reporting.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Examine the documented audit programme for all required elements.

atomic_requirements.text: When planning the audit programme, consider environmental importance, organisational changes, and previous audit results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check audit programme for references to process importance, changes, and past audit outcomes.

atomic_requirements.text: Define audit objectives, criteria, and scope for each internal audit.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review audit plans or reports for stated objectives, criteria, and scope.

atomic_requirements.text: Auditors must be selected and audits conducted to ensure objectivity and impartiality.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check auditor selection records and audit procedures for impartiality safeguards.

atomic_requirements.text: Audit results must be reported to relevant management levels and documented information must be available.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review audit reports and distribution records for evidence of management reporting.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must review the environmental management system at planned intervals to ensure its ongoing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review schedule and minutes/report for periodic management review by top management.

atomic_requirements.text: Inputs to management review must include the status of actions from previous management reviews.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for discussion of previous actions and their status.

atomic_requirements.text: Inputs to management review must include relevant changes affecting the environmental management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for discussion of relevant changes since the last review.

atomic_requirements.text: Inputs to management review must include changes in internal and external issues relevant to the management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for discussion of internal/external context changes.

atomic_requirements.text: Inputs to management review must include changes in relevant interested parties’ needs and expectations, including compliance obligations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for discussion of interested parties and compliance obligations.

atomic_requirements.text: Management review results must include conclusions on the continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the environmental management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for documented conclusions on EMS suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.

atomic_requirements.text: Management review results must include decisions on opportunities for continual improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for decisions on improvement opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: Management review results must include decisions on any need for changes to the EMS, including resources.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for decisions on EMS changes and resource needs.

atomic_requirements.text: Management review results must include actions, if needed, when environmental objectives are not achieved.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for actions related to unmet objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: Management review results must include opportunities to improve EMS integration with other business processes, if necessary.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes for discussion of EMS integration with business processes.

atomic_requirements.text: Management review results must include implications for the organisation’s strategic direction and documented evidence of the review results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review minutes/report for strategic implications and availability of documented evidence.

atomic_requirements.text: The review covers the required inputs: status of previous actions; changes in internal/external issues, compliance obligations, significant aspects, risks/opportunities; environmental performance (NC/corrective actions, monitoring results, compliance evaluation, audit results); objectives achievement; adequacy of resources; communications from interested parties (incl. complaints); opportunities for improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Map the minutes against the input list item by item. Name the items NOT discussed — that list is the finding.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Compliance-obligation evaluation results and interested-party communications (including complaints) appear among the discussed inputs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Specific mention of legal compliance status and external communications/complaints in the minutes.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Actions from previous management reviews are tracked: their status is reported and open items carried forward.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Previous-actions status table or explicit follow-up discussion in the current minutes.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: When a nonconformity occurs, the organisation must respond and, where applicable, take appropriate action.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review process for responding to nonconformities in procedures or records.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must control and correct any nonconformity that occurs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records showing nonconformities were controlled and corrected.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must address consequences of nonconformities, including mitigating negative environmental impacts.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of actions taken to mitigate environmental impacts after nonconformities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must assess if action is needed to eliminate the cause(s) of nonconformity to prevent recurrence or occurrence elsewhere.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of root cause analysis and preventive actions.
