atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must review the nonconformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify records of nonconformity reviews.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the cause(s) of the nonconformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documentation of cause analysis for nonconformities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine if similar nonconformities exist or could occur.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records showing evaluation of similar or potential nonconformities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must implement any necessary actions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of corrective actions implemented.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must review the effectiveness of any corrective action taken.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify records of effectiveness reviews for corrective actions.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must make changes to the EMS if needed; corrective actions must match the significance of nonconformity impacts.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of EMS changes and justification based on nonconformity significance.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must continually improve suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of its EMS to enhance environmental performance by identifying improvement opportunities and implementing necessary actions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of management review, audits, and improvement actions; check evidence of continual improvement and implemented actions.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify relevant internal and external factors that affect its ability to achieve intended OH&S management system outcomes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review context analysis or similar records listing internal and external factors relevant to OH&S objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine whether climate change is a relevant issue for its OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented evaluation or decision on climate change relevance for the OH&S management system.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify other relevant interested parties, beyond workers, for the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check list of identified interested parties beyond workers.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the relevant needs and expectations of workers and other interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented needs and expectations of workers and other interested parties.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify which needs and expectations are or may become legal or other requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records showing which needs and expectations are legal or other requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must define the boundaries and applicability of its OH&S management system to establish its scope.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review scope statement and supporting documents showing how boundaries and applicability were determined.

atomic_requirements.text: When defining the scope, the organisation must consider relevant internal and external factors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if scope determination references analysis of internal and external issues (see clause 4.1).

atomic_requirements.text: When defining the scope, the organisation must consider the needs and expectations of interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify if scope determination considers requirements of interested parties (see clause 4.2).

atomic_requirements.text: The scope must include all planned or performed work activities, products, and services under the organisation’s control or influence that affect OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if all relevant activities, products, and services are included in the OH&S scope statement.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented information describing the scope of its OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Request and review the documented scope statement for the OH&S management system.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management takes full responsibility and accountability for preventing work-related injury and ill health, and for providing safe and healthy workplaces.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy, organigram, delegations, and signed statements of responsibility.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures the OH&S policy and objectives are established and aligned with the organisation’s strategic direction.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review OH&S policy and objectives for alignment with strategic documents.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures OH&S management system requirements are integrated into the organisation’s business processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process maps, procedures, and integration in business planning.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures necessary resources are available to establish, implement, maintain, and improve the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource allocation records, budgets, and management review minutes.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management communicates the importance of effective OH&S management and compliance with OH&S management system requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check communication records, meeting minutes, and internal communications.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures the OH&S management system achieves its intended outcomes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review performance reports and management review outputs.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management leads and supports people to contribute to the effectiveness of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff and review evidence of leadership support.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures and promotes continual improvement of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check improvement actions, management review, and continual improvement records.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management supports other relevant management roles to demonstrate leadership in their areas of responsibility.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check delegation records, role descriptions, and evidence of support.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management develops, leads, and promotes a culture supporting the intended outcomes of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview staff and review culture-related initiatives.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management protects workers from retaliation after reporting incidents, hazards, risks, or opportunities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check whistleblowing procedures and records of incident reporting.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management ensures the organisation establishes and implements processes for worker consultation and participation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review consultation process documents and participation records.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management supports the establishment and operation of health and safety committees.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check committee establishment documents and meeting minutes.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management leads the management review and oversees OH&S performance (participation documented).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: MR minutes list top management; incident/performance data reviewed at that level.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must establish, implement and maintain an OH&S policy committing to safe, healthy working conditions, suitable to the organisation’s purpose, size, context, and OH&S risks and opportunities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for commitment to safe, healthy conditions and appropriateness to purpose, size, context, and OH&S risks/opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: The OH&S policy must provide a framework for setting OH&S objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for statement that it provides a framework for setting OH&S objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: The OH&S policy must include a commitment to fulfil legal and other requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for explicit commitment to fulfil legal and other requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The OH&S policy must include a commitment to eliminate hazards and reduce OH&S risks.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for explicit commitment to eliminate hazards and reduce OH&S risks.

atomic_requirements.text: The OH&S policy must include a commitment to continual improvement of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for explicit commitment to continual improvement of the OH&S system.

atomic_requirements.text: The OH&S policy must include a commitment to consultation and participation of workers and their representatives, if any.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check policy for explicit commitment to consultation and participation of workers and representatives.

atomic_requirements.text: The policy is communicated within the organisation, available to workers and their representatives, and to interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Distribution evidence, noticeboards, induction/training records referencing the policy.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign and communicate OSH management system responsibilities and authorities at all levels, and keep this as documented information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented assignments and communications of OSH roles and authorities at all levels.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers at every level must take responsibility for OSH management system aspects under their control.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review job descriptions, responsibilities, and evidence of worker involvement in OSH activities.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority to ensure the OSH management system meets ISO 45001 requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented assignment of responsibility for OSH system compliance.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management must assign responsibility and authority for reporting OSH management system performance to them.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented assignment for reporting OSH system performance to top management.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must have and apply processes for worker consultation and participation at all levels and stages of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented processes and evidence of worker involvement in OH&S system development, planning, implementation, evaluation, and improvement.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must provide means, time, training, and resources needed for worker consultation and participation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review resource allocation, training records, and meeting schedules supporting worker consultation and participation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must provide timely access to clear, understandable, and relevant OH&S management system information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check communication records and information provided to workers about the OH&S management system.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify and remove barriers to participation, and minimise those that cannot be removed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of barrier identification, actions taken to remove or minimise obstacles to worker participation.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers (or their representatives) are consulted on hazard identification and risk assessment — with evidence, not just declared.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: RLS signature/participation on the DVR or risk assessment records; consultation minutes referencing the assessment.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Workers have a working channel to report hazards, near misses and OH&S concerns.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Near-miss/hazard report forms with actual entries, reporting procedure, suggestion records.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Workers participate in incident investigation and in the development of policy and objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Investigation records listing worker/RLS involvement; consultation evidence on policy/objectives.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: When planning, the organisation must identify risks and opportunities to ensure the OH&S management system achieves its intended outcomes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check planning documents for identification of risks/opportunities linked to achieving intended outcomes.

atomic_requirements.text: When planning, the organisation must identify risks and opportunities to prevent or reduce undesired effects.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review planning records for risks/opportunities addressing prevention or reduction of undesired effects.

atomic_requirements.text: When planning, the organisation must identify risks and opportunities to achieve continual improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check planning process for risks/opportunities linked to continual improvement.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine and assess OH&S risks and opportunities related to changes in the organisation, its processes, or the OH&S system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review change management and planning records for risk/opportunity assessment linked to organisational or process changes.

atomic_requirements.text: For planned, permanent or temporary changes, risk and opportunity assessment must occur before implementing the change.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented change records for pre-implementation risk/opportunity assessment.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information on the risks and opportunities and on the planning processes is maintained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Maintained register or planning document with revision control.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Workers (and their representatives) are consulted in the risk/opportunity planning process.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Consultation records, RLS signature on the risk documents, safety committee minutes feeding the planning.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Potential emergency situations are identified among the planning inputs (link to emergency preparedness, 8.2).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Emergency scenarios referenced in the planning/risk documents, coherent with the emergency plan.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain ongoing proactive processes to identify hazards.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented procedures for hazard identification and evidence of their application.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification processes must consider work organisation, social factors, leadership, and organisational culture.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessment forms and procedures for inclusion of social and organisational factors.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must cover both routine and non-routine activities and situations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for coverage of routine and non-routine tasks.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider infrastructure, equipment, materials, substances, and physical workplace conditions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessments for inclusion of workplace conditions and equipment.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider product/service design, R&D, testing, production, assembly, construction, service delivery, maintenance, and disposal.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for all lifecycle stages of products/services.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider human factors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if human factors are addressed in risk assessment templates and records.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider how work is performed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessments for consideration of work methods.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider relevant past incidents, including emergencies and their causes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if incident history is referenced in hazard identification records.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider potential emergency situations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for emergency scenarios.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider people, including their characteristics and needs.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessments for consideration of different people affected.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider all persons accessing the workplace, including workers, contractors, visitors, and others.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for inclusion of contractors, visitors, and other persons.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider people near the workplace who may be affected by organisational activities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risk assessments consider neighbours or the public.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider workers at locations not directly controlled by the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for off-site or remote workers.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider other relevant factors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessment scope for inclusion of other relevant factors.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider workplace, process, installation, equipment, and work organisation design, including suitability for workers.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if design and suitability are considered in risk assessments.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider nearby situations caused by work-related activities under organisational control.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for adjacent area risks from organisational activities.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider uncontrolled situations near the workplace that could harm people at work.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments for external, uncontrolled risks.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider actual or proposed changes in the organisation, operations, processes, or OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risk assessments are updated after organisational or process changes.

atomic_requirements.text: Hazard identification must consider changes in hazard knowledge and information.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if new information triggers risk assessment updates.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain processes to assess OH&S risks from identified hazards, considering effectiveness of existing controls.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessment records for evaluation of risks and controls.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain processes to determine and assess other risks related to the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risks to the OH&S management system itself are assessed.

atomic_requirements.text: Risk assessment methodologies and criteria must be defined, relevant to scope, nature, and timing, ensuring proactive and systematic use.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented risk assessment methodology and criteria.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information on risk assessment methodology and criteria must be maintained and retained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for controlled documents and records of risk assessment methodology.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain processes to assess OH&S opportunities to improve performance, considering planned changes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risk assessments include evaluation of improvement opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must assess opportunities to adapt work, work organisation, and workplace to workers.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if assessments consider adapting work and workplace to workers’ needs.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must assess opportunities to eliminate hazards and reduce OH&S risks.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risk assessments identify opportunities for hazard elimination and risk reduction.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must assess other opportunities to improve the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if improvement opportunities for the OH&S system are identified and assessed.

atomic_requirements.text: Methodology is actually applied — risks carry scores and prioritisation, not just qualitative narrative.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Each hazard has a numerical score / band; prioritisation drives control selection.
atomic_requirements.review_note: scores and ranking are not required, only a defined method

atomic_requirements.text: Review frequency for the risk assessment is defined and respected.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Stated revision date in DVR (e.g. annual or after process change); evidence of timely update.
atomic_requirements.review_note: no review frequency is required

atomic_requirements.text: Control measures follow the hierarchy of controls (elimination > substitution > engineering > admin > PPE).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Controls are not exclusively PPE; engineering or organisational measures appear.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Workers (or their representatives) are consulted during hazard identification.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: RLS / worker signature on DVR; reference to consultation in revision history.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain processes to identify and access current legal and other applicable requirements for OH&S hazards, risks and management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented procedures for identifying and accessing updated legal and other requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine how legal and other requirements apply and what needs to be communicated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check procedures showing how requirements are assessed for applicability and communication needs.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider legal and other requirements in establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving its OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify process documents showing requirements are integrated into OH&S system activities and improvements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must maintain documented information on its legal and other requirements, ensuring it is current and reflects any changes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented information on requirements; check evidence of updates and change management.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must align with the OH&S policy.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives for consistency with the OH&S policy.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must be measurable or allow performance evaluation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify objectives have metrics or performance evaluation criteria.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must consider relevant factors.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review objectives for consideration of risk, legal, and consultation outcomes.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must consider applicable requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives reference legal and other applicable requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must consider risk and opportunity assessment results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives reflect risk and opportunity assessment outcomes.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must consider worker consultation results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check objectives reflect outcomes of worker consultation.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must be monitored.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of monitoring status for each objective.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must be communicated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records or evidence of communication of objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S objectives must be updated as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if objectives are reviewed and updated when needed.

atomic_requirements.text: Plans to achieve objectives must specify what will be done.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented plans for defined actions.

atomic_requirements.text: Plans to achieve objectives must specify required resources.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented plans for resource allocation.

atomic_requirements.text: Plans to achieve objectives must specify responsible persons.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented plans for assigned responsibilities.

atomic_requirements.text: Plans to achieve objectives must specify completion deadlines.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented plans for deadlines.

atomic_requirements.text: Plans to achieve objectives must specify how results will be evaluated, including monitoring indicators.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented plans for evaluation and monitoring indicators.

atomic_requirements.text: Actions to achieve objectives must be integrated into business processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if plans and actions are embedded in business processes.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information on OH&S objectives and plans to achieve them must be maintained and retained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for documented objectives and plans, and evidence of retention.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must identify the necessary competencies for workers affecting or potentially affecting OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review how required competencies are determined for relevant roles.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must ensure workers are competent, including hazard identification, based on suitable education, training, or experience.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence that workers meet required competencies, including hazard identification.

atomic_requirements.text: Where applicable, the organisation must take and assess actions to acquire, maintain, and evaluate necessary competencies.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify records of actions taken for competence and their effectiveness.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented information as evidence of worker competence.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented evidence of competence, such as certificates or training records.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers are made aware of the OH&S policy and the OH&S objectives relevant to them.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training records, induction materials, or communications referencing OH&S policy and objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers are aware of how their actions contribute to OH&S management effectiveness and the benefits of improved OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review training content and awareness campaigns explaining individual roles and benefits of OH&S improvements.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers are aware of the possible implications and consequences of not conforming to OH&S management system requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training or communication materials covering consequences of non-compliance with OH&S requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers are informed about incidents that concern them and the results of related investigations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review incident communication records, safety alerts, or meeting minutes sharing investigation results.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers are made aware of hazards, OH&S risks, and relevant actions that concern them.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check training records, risk communication, or toolbox talks covering hazards and controls.

atomic_requirements.text: Workers are informed of their right to remove themselves from serious and imminent danger without unjust consequences.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check induction or training materials explaining the right to stop work in dangerous situations.

atomic_requirements.text: Awareness extends to contractors and visitors where they are exposed to the organisation's hazards.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Contractor site inductions, visitor briefings, DUVRI-related communications.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must set criteria for processes to meet OH&S management system requirements and actions from clause 6.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented process criteria for OH&S and actions from clause 6.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must control processes according to established criteria to meet OH&S management system requirements and actions from clause 6.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of process controls applied as per defined criteria.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented information to confirm processes were carried out as planned.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records showing processes performed as planned.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must adapt work to workers and coordinate OH&S management with other employers at shared workplaces.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of work adaptation and coordination with other employers.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish processes to eliminate hazards using the hierarchy of controls, starting with hazard elimination.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process documentation for hazard elimination as first control.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must substitute less hazardous processes, activities, materials, or equipment as part of hazard control.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review evidence of substitution with less hazardous options.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must use engineering controls and reorganise work to reduce OH&S risks.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documentation of engineering controls and work reorganisation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must apply administrative controls, including training, to reduce OH&S risks.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of administrative controls and training.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must use suitable personal protective equipment to reduce OH&S risks.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of PPE provision and use.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish processes to implement and control planned changes affecting OH&S performance, including new or changed products, services, or processes.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process documentation for managing planned changes impacting OH&S.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must review consequences of unintended changes and take actions to mitigate negative effects as needed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records of unintended change reviews and mitigation actions.

atomic_requirements.text: A process exists and is applied to control procurement of products and services for OH&S management system conformity.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented procurement process and evidence of its application.

atomic_requirements.text: Procurement processes are coordinated with contractors to identify hazards and control OH&S risks from contractor activities impacting the organisation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check coordination records and risk assessments for contractor activities affecting the organisation.

atomic_requirements.text: Procurement processes are coordinated with contractors to identify hazards and control OH&S risks from organisation activities impacting contractor workers.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments and coordination records for organisation activities affecting contractor workers.

atomic_requirements.text: Procurement processes are coordinated with contractors to identify hazards and control OH&S risks from contractor activities impacting other workplace parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check risk assessments and coordination records for contractor activities affecting third parties.

atomic_requirements.text: Contractors and their workers meet the organisation’s OH&S management system requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review contractor qualification records and evidence of compliance with OH&S requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S criteria are defined and applied for contractor selection.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented selection criteria and application records for contractors.

atomic_requirements.text: Outsourced functions and processes are controlled.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review records showing control of outsourced functions and processes.

atomic_requirements.text: Outsourcing agreements align with legal, other requirements, and OH&S management system objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check outsourcing agreements for compliance with legal and OH&S requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The type and extent of control for outsourced functions and processes are defined in the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review management system documents defining control levels for outsourcing.

atomic_requirements.text: Contractors receive a documented site-specific safety briefing before commencing work.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Briefing records signed by contractor representatives; specific to the site and activity.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a documented briefing is a way to do it, not a requirement

atomic_requirements.text: Contractor activities classified as high-risk (work at height, electrical, confined spaces) carry specific OH&S controls.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Permit-to-work, specific JSA, supervisor presence documented for high-risk contractor jobs.
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: Contractor OH&S performance is monitored (inspections, audits, incident reporting).
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Contractor audit reports, inspection records, or incident logs referencing contractors.
atomic_requirements.review_note: monitoring contractor performance is not explicit in 8.1.4

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain processes to prepare for and respond to potential emergencies, including planned emergency response and first aid.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented emergency response and first aid procedures.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must provide training for the planned emergency response.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review training records and emergency response training plans.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must regularly test and conduct drills to assess emergency response capability as planned.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of emergency drills and test schedules.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must evaluate performance and review planned emergency response, especially after drills or real emergencies.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review post-drill and post-incident evaluation and revision records.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must communicate relevant information to all workers about their emergency obligations and responsibilities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check communication records and worker briefings on emergency roles.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must communicate relevant emergency information to contractors, visitors, emergency services, authorities, and, where appropriate, the local community.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review communication logs with external parties regarding emergency procedures.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must consider the needs and abilities of relevant interested parties and involve them, as appropriate, in developing emergency response.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of stakeholder involvement in emergency planning.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must maintain and retain documented information on emergency response processes and plans.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify existence and control of documented emergency response plans.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain one or more processes to monitor, measure, analyse and evaluate OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented processes for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation of OH&S performance.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine what needs to be monitored and measured for OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review list of defined KPIs and monitoring items in procedures or plans.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the extent to which legal and other requirements are fulfilled.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check process and records for evaluating compliance with legal and other OH&S requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine which activities and operations relate to identified hazards, risks and opportunities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review risk assessment and operational control documentation for links to hazards, risks and opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine progress towards achieving its OH&S objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records showing measurement and review of progress against OH&S objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine the effectiveness of operational and other controls.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review analysis or reports on control effectiveness, e.g. audit or inspection results.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation to ensure valid results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine criteria for evaluating its OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documented performance criteria for OH&S KPIs and objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine when monitoring and measurement must be performed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check schedules or plans specifying frequency of monitoring and measurement.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine when monitoring and measurement results are analysed, evaluated and communicated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review procedures or records showing timing of analysis, evaluation and communication of results.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must evaluate OH&S performance and determine the effectiveness of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of performance evaluation and system effectiveness reviews.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must ensure monitoring and measurement equipment is calibrated or verified, used and maintained appropriately.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check calibration records and maintenance logs for monitoring and measurement equipment.

atomic_requirements.text: KPI set includes both leading (preventive: inspections, training hours, near miss rate) and lagging (reactive: incidents, lost-time injuries) indicators.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Mix of preventive and reactive metrics, not only injury counts.
atomic_requirements.review_note: the mix of leading and lagging indicators is good practice

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must establish, implement and maintain one or more processes to evaluate compliance with legal and other requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented processes for compliance evaluation; confirm implementation and maintenance.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must determine how often and by which methods compliance will be evaluated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review documents specifying frequency and methods for compliance evaluation.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must evaluate compliance and take action if needed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of compliance evaluations and any resulting actions taken.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must maintain knowledge and understanding of its compliance status with legal and other requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify evidence that compliance status is known and understood by relevant personnel.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented information on the results of compliance evaluations.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for documented evidence of compliance evaluation results.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine if the OH&S management system is conforming.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check audit schedule and reports for evidence of planned internal audits.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must verify conformity to the organisation’s own OH&S policy, objectives, and requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review audit criteria and reports for checks against internal OH&S policy and objectives.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must verify conformity to the requirements of ISO 45001:2018.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check audit criteria and reports for reference to ISO 45001 requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: Internal audits must determine if the OH&S management system is effectively implemented and maintained.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review audit reports for evaluation of system effectiveness and maintenance.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must plan, establish, implement, and maintain an audit programme covering frequency, methods, responsibilities, consultation, planning, and reporting.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Examine the documented audit programme for all required elements.

atomic_requirements.text: Audit criteria and scope must be defined for each internal audit.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check audit plans or terms of reference for defined criteria and scope.

atomic_requirements.text: Auditors must be selected and audits conducted to ensure objectivity and impartiality.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review auditor selection records and audit procedures for impartiality safeguards.

atomic_requirements.text: Audit results must be reported to relevant managers, workers, worker representatives, and other interested parties as appropriate.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check distribution lists and communication records for audit results.

atomic_requirements.text: Actions must be taken to address nonconformities and continually improve OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review corrective action records and improvement plans linked to audit findings.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information must be retained as evidence of audit results and audit programme implementation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for retained audit reports and records of audit programme execution.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management reviews the OH&S management system at planned intervals to ensure it remains suitable, adequate and effective.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review schedule and minutes for regularity, attendance, and scope.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers the status of actions from previous management reviews.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for agenda/minutes referencing follow-up on previous review actions.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers changes in relevant internal and external issues affecting the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for discussion of changes in context, risks, or legal requirements.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers the needs and expectations of interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for reference to stakeholder needs and expectations.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers legal and other requirements relevant to OH&S.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for agenda/minutes covering legal compliance and other obligations.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers OH&S risks and opportunities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for discussion of risks and opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers achievement of the OH&S policy and objectives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for review of policy and objectives achievement.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers OH&S performance information, including trends.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for performance data and trend analysis in review records.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers incidents, nonconformities, corrective actions, and continual improvement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for discussion of incidents, nonconformities, and improvements.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers results of monitoring and measurement.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for monitoring and measurement results in review documentation.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers results of evaluation of compliance with legal and other requirements.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for compliance evaluation results in review records.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers audit results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for audit results discussed in review minutes.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers outcomes of worker consultation and participation.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for worker input or consultation outcomes.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers OH&S risks and opportunities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for discussion of risks and opportunities.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers adequacy of resources for maintaining an effective OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Look for resource adequacy discussed in review records.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers relevant communications with interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check minutes for reference to communications with stakeholders.

atomic_requirements.text: The review considers opportunities for continual improvement and outputs include related decisions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check review outputs for improvement opportunities and related decisions.

atomic_requirements.text: Top management communicates relevant management review results to workers and their representatives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check evidence of communication of review results to workers/representatives.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation retains documented information as evidence of management review results.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check for retained records of management review results.

atomic_requirements.text: A process exists and is maintained for reporting, investigating, and managing incidents and nonconformities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check documented procedure for incident and nonconformity management.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation reacts promptly to incidents or nonconformities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review incident records for response times.

atomic_requirements.text: Actions are taken to control and correct incidents or nonconformities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of actions taken after incidents.

atomic_requirements.text: Consequences of incidents or nonconformities are addressed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review incident reports for actions addressing consequences.

atomic_requirements.text: Need for corrective actions is evaluated with worker participation and relevant interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records for evidence of worker involvement in corrective action decisions.

atomic_requirements.text: Incidents are investigated or nonconformities reviewed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check investigation reports for each incident or nonconformity.

atomic_requirements.text: Causes of incidents or nonconformities are determined.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review root cause analysis in incident records.

atomic_requirements.text: Similar incidents or nonconformities are identified or anticipated.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if records show review for similar or potential incidents.

atomic_requirements.text: Existing OH&S risk assessments are reviewed as appropriate after incidents or nonconformities.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risk assessments are updated after incidents.

atomic_requirements.text: Necessary actions, including corrective actions, are implemented using the hierarchy of controls and change management.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check action plans for use of hierarchy of controls and change management.

atomic_requirements.text: OH&S risks from new or changed hazards are assessed before taking action.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if risk assessments precede corrective actions for new hazards.

atomic_requirements.text: Effectiveness of actions taken, including corrective actions, is reviewed.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records for post-action effectiveness reviews.

atomic_requirements.text: The OH&S management system is changed if needed; corrective actions are appropriate to actual or potential effects.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check if system changes are made after significant incidents.

atomic_requirements.text: Documented information is communicated to affected workers, worker representatives, and relevant interested parties.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check communication records to workers and representatives.

atomic_requirements.text: Near misses are actually recorded — not only injury events.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Register containing near-miss entries; volume consistent with workplace activity (zero near misses is itself a red flag).
atomic_requirements.review_note: a requirement of the standard stands behind it (reviewed 2026-10-12)

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the OH&S management system by enhancing OH&S performance.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review performance indicators, improvement plans, and evidence of actions taken to improve OH&S results.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the OH&S management system by promoting a culture supporting OH&S management.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Interview workers and management to confirm promotion of a positive OH&S culture and supporting initiatives.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the OH&S management system by promoting worker participation in improvement actions.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Check records of worker involvement in improvement actions, meeting minutes, and interviews with workers.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the OH&S management system by communicating relevant improvement results to workers and their representatives.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Review communication records, notices, emails, or meeting minutes showing results shared with workers and representatives.

atomic_requirements.text: The organisation must retain documented information as evidence of continual improvement of the OH&S management system.
atomic_requirements.verification_hint: Verify existence and retention of records evidencing continual improvement, such as reports, reviews, and action logs.
